description: CVD direction + reversal. Bar 0 is net aggressive BUYING (barDelta > 0, CVD rises). Bar 1 is net aggressive SELLING (barDelta < 0, CVD falls — the reversal). Bar 2 is net buying again (CVD rises). Asserts CVD is the running cumulative of per-bar delta and reverses direction exactly when a bar's barDelta flips sign, and that delta = ask_volume - bid_volume per bar.
